svg.text: Natural deduction has both properties, for propositional and first-order logic:

text.font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif

svg.text: Γ ⊢ A exactly when Γ ⊨ A. So a counterexample shows that no derivation exists.
